title: C.I.D Voice Pack
description: C.I.D voice pack is added to game through DvD And used in juke box.
body:
CID Voice Pack is a unique and entertaining Minecraft resource pack that brings the legendary dialogues of the famous Indian TV series CID directly into your world. This pack replaces the sounds played by jukebox music discs with iconic voice lines and memorable moments from the show. Whether you are a long-time fan of CID or simply enjoy adding humor and personality to your Minecraft experience, this resource pack offers a fresh and nostalgic way to enjoy the game. Every sound has been carefully selected and edited to provide clear audio while preserving the original feel of the classic dialogues that made CID so popular across India.
The pack features 11 different music discs, each containing a different CID voice clip. Simply place a music disc into a jukebox and enjoy hearing famous dialogues from beloved characters while exploring, building, mining, or hanging out with friends. From dramatic investigations to unforgettable punchlines, every disc adds a touch of comedy and nostalgia to your Minecraft adventures. The sounds are integrated seamlessly into the game, making them easy to use without affecting normal gameplay. It is a fun way to surprise friends on multiplayer servers or create entertaining moments during your gameplay sessions.
CID Voice Pack is designed for players who love customizing Minecraft and want something different from traditional music packs. The resource pack is lightweight, easy to install, and compatible with the standard jukebox system. If you enjoy Indian pop culture, classic television references, and creative Minecraft content, this pack is a perfect addition to your collection. Download it, play your favorite discs, and relive some of the most iconic CID moments right inside Minecraft. Daya, kuch toh gadbad hai… and now it’s in Minecraft!
